facts.fact: The PATN steering committee, at its fifth session on 26 February 2026, recommended continuing and intensifying efforts to extend internet access within public administrations, town halls (mairies) among them with ministries and hospitals, so that they can interconnect with the state's digital platforms, and approved reallocating funds towards the connectivity component; ACI reports it and gives no number of town halls connected.
facts.system: Extension of internet access to public administrations under the Projet d'accélération de la transformation numérique (Patn)

facts.fact: The internet access the PATN steering committee asked on 26 February 2026 to be extended is access within the public administrations themselves, town halls included, provided under the state's project; the document describes an effort to be continued and does not say any town hall is connected.
facts.system: Extension of internet access to public administrations under the Projet d'accélération de la transformation numérique (Patn)

facts.fact: The PATN, under which internet access is to be extended to ministries, town halls and hospitals, is financed by the World Bank for US$100 million and its 2026 work plan and budget was adopted at XAF 21.872 billion on 26 February 2026, according to ACI.
facts.system: Extension of internet access to public administrations under the Projet d'accélération de la transformation numérique (Patn)

facts.fact: ACI's account of the PATN steering committee of 26 February 2026 names town halls among the administrations to be given internet access and gives no count or share of town halls connected.
facts.system: Extension of internet access to public administrations under the Projet d'accélération de la transformation numérique (Patn)
